% !tp-example Basic usage
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpBox[data-tp-color-scope]{
  \rawhtml|<tp-control value="color,theme"></tp-control>|
  Change the color or theme of this box. The inline code \rawhtml*|<code>hello(world)</code>| uses the selected brand color.

}
\end{document}

% !tp-example Javascript API
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcScript[type=module]|
import "/components/box/box.js";
import "/components/control/control.js";

const example = document.createDocumentFragment();

const element1 = document.createElement("tp-box");
element1.setAttribute("data-tp-color-scope", "");
element1.append(document.createTextNode("\n  "));

const element2 = document.createElement("tp-control");
element2.setAttribute("value", "color,theme");
element1.append(element2);
element1.append(document.createTextNode("\n  "));

const element3 = document.createElement("p");
element3.append(document.createTextNode("Change the color or theme of this box. The inline code "));

const element4 = document.createElement("code");
element4.append(document.createTextNode("hello(world)"));
element3.append(element4);
element3.append(document.createTextNode(" uses the selected brand color."));
element1.append(element3);
element1.append(document.createTextNode("\n"));
example.append(element1);

document.body.append(example);
|
\end{document}

% !tp-example All controllers
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\rawhtml|<tp-control value="clock,lang,dir,color,theme,screen,fullscreen" langs="en,fr"></tp-control>|
\end{document}

% !tp-example Initially hidden
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpControl{}
\end{document}
